title: Raft Theme Review
description: A documentation-led profile of Raft’s full-site-editing approach, patterns, and broad block-editor compatibility claims.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped, documentation-led Raft WordPress theme profile from KreativWP.
highlights: The official listing describes Raft as a full-site-editing-compatible theme
Its stated use cases include content sites, businesses, portfolios, and WooCommerce storefronts
The listing documents block patterns and compatibility with the block editor alongside popular page builders
bestFor: Teams seeking a pattern-led FSE starting point who will test their preferred editor and commerce requirements before committing.
researchScope: This profile checks Raft’s current WordPress.org listing and official theme page. It summarizes documented workflow and stated compatibility, not independent speed or compatibility testing.
caveats: No controlled install, builder compatibility test, checkout study, or accessibility audit has been completed. Treat broad compatibility claims as a starting point for staging validation.
